text: Water takes the shape of its vessel, yet a heart must keep its own shape even when shaken.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Flow like water, root like a tree — a shaken heart still survives!

text: The moment you call the road long, your steps have already half stopped.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: If the road feels long, your feet already stopped. Feet are stronger than thoughts!

text: The mountain is never afraid of its height. Only those who climb know the summit.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: The mountain never flinches. Only climbing legs know the summit!

text: A deep well is silent. Only shallow knowledge makes noise.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Noisy knowledge is shallow. Stack quietly, stand greatly!

text: Morning dew does not stay long. That is why it shines so brightly.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Dew doesn't shine to stay — it blooms now and vanishes now.

text: A tree does not cling to withered leaves; it clears room for new ones.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Don't grip withered leaves. Empty the branch, and new ones come!

text: The rock cannot defeat water. What flows is stronger than what hardens.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: The hard doesn't beat the flowing. Flow wins!

text: A lamp never knows its own shadow deepens the more it lights others.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: You who light others — mind your own shadow too.

text: Grain bows lower as it ripens. People, too, grow lower as they mature.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: The riper the grain, the lower the bow. Humility is skill!

text: Hasty water is shallow. A deep river flows without a sound.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: A deep river is silent. Loud water is shallow water.

text: Even when a stone strikes it, flowing water answers with new water. Reply through flow.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Even stoned, flowing water answers with new flow. Flow is the reply!

text: A bow is better taut, but a person must also know how to loosen.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Bow taut, heart loose! Know both, and you'll never miss.

text: Rather than cursing the dark, light one small candle.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Don't curse the dark — light one candle. That's the goblin way!

text: A thief steals from your house; time steals your life. Cherish today.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Time is the greatest thief. Lock in today before it's gone!

text: A bell rings only when struck first. A heart opens only when knocked.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Knock, and it opens — doors and hearts alike!

text: A brimming vessel spills. Only an empty one receives what is new.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: A full vessel spills. Empty it, and new luck pours in!

text: A forest is not one tree. Together, they block the wind.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: One tree may snap, but a forest stands. Together is strength!

text: Water hidden in a valley reaches the sea first. The low road is fast.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: The low stream reaches the sea first. Humility is the shortcut!

text: A hawk is a hawk even when flying low. Silence does not mean smallness.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: A hawk flying low is still a hawk. Silence isn't weakness!

text: Roots are invisible, yet they are the whole of the tree. Skill grows underground.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Roots are invisible but they're everything. Grow your skill underground!

text: To see a rainbow you must endure the rain. The order cannot be skipped.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: The rainbow comes after the rain. Never skip the order!

text: A mirror breaks in anger, but the mirror of the heart you must polish yourself.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Don't blame the broken mirror — watch the hand that polishes!

text: Sand clutched tightly runs through your fingers. Holding on begins with looseness.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Sand escapes a tight fist. Hold gently!

text: If you lost your way a hundred times, you also found it a hundred times.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Lost a hundred times, found a hundred times — that's mastery!

text: Many candles split the dark without quarreling. Light stays together.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Candles never fight each other. Lights share the dark!

text: A scale speaks truth only when both sides are level.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: A scale speaks truth only when level. Keep your balance!

text: The sea holds fish because it lies low. The lower you are, the more you hold.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: The sea holds much because it lies low. Lower yourself, hold more!

text: The rooster wakes the morning, but the morning belongs to no one. Starting is your own share.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Nobody hands you your morning. Open your own day!

text: Tap even a stepping stone twice before crossing. Safety comes from tapping.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Tap even the stone bridge twice. Tapping is treasure!

text: Melted spring snow makes the summer river. A small flow changes a season.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: A handful of spring snow builds the summer river. Flow, even small!

text: A quiet night puts the day in order. Rest is part of the work.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: The resting night is work too. Tidying comes before the light!

text: An arrow flies farther the farther it is drawn back. Retreat is a leap in preparation.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: The arrow drawn back flies farthest. Don't be ashamed of retreat!

text: Ice does not announce how cold it was; it melts and simply flows.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Ice says nothing — it just melts and flows. That's the answer!

text: A flower may bloom because the silence of its roots allowed it.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: A flower blooms because its roots stayed silent. Praise prepared silence!

text: The moon and the dew both return the day. Today is borrowed.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Today is borrowed. Spend it like you'll pay interest!

text: A hundred words say less than one step that smells of earth.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: One earthy step beats a hundred words!

text: Water in a sealed jar rots. A heart must flow to stay alive.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Stagnant rots, flowing lives. Change your heart's water!

text: The seagull does not prophesy the storm. Wings are forged in storms.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Wings aren't forged in clear skies. The storm is the teacher!

text: Even a small spring snow, once melted, moves the season.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Even a bit of melting snow moves the season. Never scorn small starts!

text: Things can be set down, but the mind rarely does. Lay down the mind's load first.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Things can be put down, but the mind clings. Drop the mind's load first!

text: A great tree grows deep roots only after weathering storms.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: No great tree without storms. Shaking deepens roots!

text: A snake must shed its skin to grow. Clinging to the old self is not growth.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Shed the skin to grow! Clinging to the old you isn't growth!

text: A climber watches the next foothold, not the summit.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Climbers watch the next foothold, not the peak!

text: A bird does not fall when the branch breaks. Trust the wings, not the branch.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: When the branch breaks, the wings remain. Trust wings, not branches!

text: Barley must endure winter to become bread.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Barley endures winter to become bread. Patience is the mill!

text: You cannot clap with one hand. Relationships are each other's sound.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: One hand cannot clap. Relationships are each other's sound!

text: The long night hides the morning inside. Night is not the end, but the waiting room.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: The long night is the morning's waiting room. It's not the end!

text: A seed loses its shape underground. Change begins with letting go.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: A seed sheds its shape to sprout. Change starts with shedding!

text: A river does not rush to arrive far. It deepens at every turn.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Hasty rivers are shallow. They deepen at every bend!

text: The day you live today becomes tomorrow's strength. A day cannot be rewritten.
author: Kkaebi Wisdom Notes
kkaebi_comment: Today cannot be rewritten. Leave it as a fine line of wisdom!

text: Actions speak louder than words — what you do outweighs what you say.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Start, and you're halfway there. The goblin favors a good first button!

text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step — great things start small.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Dig one well deep. The spring belongs to the digger!

text: The early bird catches the worm — preparation beats talent arriving late.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Soft words come back soft. Words are a mirror!

text: Don't count your chickens before they hatch — outcomes belong to the finished.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Hardship is a savings account. Joy arrives as interest!

text: When the going gets tough, the tough get going — pressure reveals character.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Speak of it and it appears? Then speak only good things!

text: Every cloud has a silver lining — hardship hides a gift inside.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Acorns measure up much the same — stay humble, it's the seatbelt!

text: Practice makes perfect — repetition is the mother of skill.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Fixing late is still wise. Losing the ox once teaches forever!

text: Better late than never — a late start still beats standing still.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Familiar work is easy work — like eating cold porridge!

text: Two heads are better than one — shared thinking multiplies answers.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Even a ditch hides a dragon. Never mock the lowly!

text: Rome wasn't built in a day — great things take time to stand.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Look at the seed and you'll see the harvest. What did you plant today?

text: Where there's a will, there's a way — resolve carves the path.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Tap ten times. On the eleventh, the heart opens!

text: Look before you leap — a second of checking saves a week of regret.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Over one hill, rest. The next hill always comes!

text: The grass is always greener on the other side — envy distorts distance.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Groom your own wings instead of envying another's feathers!

text: Make hay while the sun shines — opportunity has opening hours.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: No perfect chicken? The best alternative is still wisdom!

text: Don't put all your eggs in one basket — spread what you cannot afford to lose.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: An empty cart is the loudest. Skill makes the sound!

text: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush — the sure thing holds value.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Even a mouse hole gets its sunlight. Now is a time to endure!

text: Strike while the iron is hot — timing turns effort into results.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: A thousand miles starts with one step. Today's step wins!

text: You can't judge a book by its cover — depth lives under the surface.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Heavy loads feel light when lifted together — asking is strength!

text: Haste makes waste — rushed work returns as rework.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: A brimming vessel speaks little. Learn from the deep and quiet!

text: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree — origins echo onward.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Those in the same boat understand each other. Empathy is free comfort!

text: Slow and steady wins the race — consistency outlasts bursts.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Everyone has their own seat. That seat is worthy too!

text: Absence makes the heart grow fonder — distance tunes affection.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: This too shall pass. Storms have short shelf lives!

text: Necessity is the mother of invention — being stuck births new doors.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Don't judge the melon by its rind!

text: A chain is only as strong as its weakest link — strength is systemic.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: At a dead end, look up. There are holes in the ceiling too!

text: The squeaky wheel gets the grease — a voiced need gets answered.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Don't grab spilled water. Draw fresh water!

text: Don't cry over spilled milk — what's gone is a lesson, not a loss.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Even lying down, the prepared eat the rice cakes!

text: All that glitters is not gold — shine is not the same as worth.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Coincidence stacks into false cause. Don't be shaken!

text: Fortune favors the bold — hesitation taxes the brave.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Even pearls must be strung to shine. Organization is a weapon!

text: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure — early care saves late pain.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Words travel a thousand miles without feet — watch today's words!

text: Every dog has its day — everyone's season comes around.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Skilled at what you chase, you'll catch anything!

text: If it ain't broke, don't fix it — respect what already works.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Full belly, better judgment. Eat first, then decide!

text: You reap what you sow — the harvest remembers the seed.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Sandcastles fall to water. Lay the foundation first!

text: There's no such thing as a free lunch — everything costs something.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Fill the root first — a bottomless jug never fills!

text: It takes two to tango — conflict and dance both need two.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: The riper the barley, the lower the bow. Learning humbles!

text: When in Rome, do as the Romans do — adapt to flourish.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Less greed, less storm!

text: The pen is mightier than the sword — written ideas outlive battles.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Desperation is a voice that calls the sky. Spend it carefully!

text: Still waters run deep — the quiet ones carry the most.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Poorly dressed pretense always shows. Being real is more intimidating!

text: Blood is thicker than water — family ties run first and deep.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Climb the height and it's just a mountain. Fear shrinks underfoot!

text: Curiosity killed the cat, but satisfaction brought it back — asking is worth it.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Waiting is also preparation. The sun will come!

text: A watched pot never boils — waiting slows down the watchful.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Big decisions always cost something. Do the math!

text: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago; the second best is now — start anyway.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: A floating heart lifts the body. Plant your feet first!

text: What doesn't kill you makes you stronger — surviving is training.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: The steady one smiles last, however steep the mountains!

text: Many hands make light work — burdens divide when shared.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: The nearest things are easiest to miss. Look right in front of you!

text: Out of sight, out of mind — presence is a kind of effort.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Even masters fall from trees. Add humility to mistakes!

text: You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make it drink — change must be chosen.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Alone you're fast; together you're far. Which do you want?

text: Too many cooks spoil the broth — too many chiefs, no order.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: One word repays a thousand-nyang debt. Feel the weight of words!

text: A picture is worth a thousand words — showing beats telling.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Patience is a hammer that turns impossible into possible!

text: Good things come to those who wait — patience is a collector.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Tall trees know the wind will bend them — and grow tall anyway!

text: If at first you don't succeed, try, try again — failure is a draft.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Small peppers are the hottest. Size isn't flavor!

text: Time heals all wounds — the clock is also a medicine.
author: English Proverb
kkaebi_comment: Don't pour soy sauce from your old-age purse. Winter firewood is gathered in summer!

text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: 노자
kkaebi_comment: Start with that first step — today's step is the beginning!

text: Learning without thought is labor lost; thought without learning is perilous.
author: 공자
kkaebi_comment: Learn and think — doing only one is half a person!

text: Care about the end as much as the beginning, and nothing will fail.
author: 노자
kkaebi_comment: Careful to the end knows no defeat!

text: Knowing is not as good as loving; loving is not as good as delighting.
author: 공자
kkaebi_comment: Enjoy what you learn. What did you delight in today?

text: Great wisdom is broad and at ease.
author: 장자
kkaebi_comment: Great wisdom sits quietly. Respect depth that doesn't shout!

text: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
author: 세네카
kkaebi_comment: Prepare the axe — luck knocks on prepared doors!

text: It is not things that disturb you, but your judgments about them.
author: 마르쿠스 아우렐리우스
kkaebi_comment: Can't change the world? Change the judgment first!

text: People are disturbed not by things, but by the views they take of them.
author: 에픽테토스
kkaebi_comment: It's the eyes that hurt, not the facts. Wash them!

text: Know thyself.
author: 전통 격언
kkaebi_comment: Knowing yourself is the first step of every journey!

text: The beginning is the most important part of the work.
author: 플라톤
kkaebi_comment: Beginnings are hardest — that's why they're greatest!

text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence is a habit.
author: 아리스토텔레스
kkaebi_comment: Repeat, and it becomes you. Good habits build a good you!

text: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
author: 아리스토텔레스
kkaebi_comment: The fruit of patience is sweet, even if the chewing isn't!

text: Death is nothing to us.
author: 에피쿠로스
kkaebi_comment: Death isn't your business today. Think only of today!

text: Fortune favors the bold.
author: 오비디우스
kkaebi_comment: Be bold! Goblins don't linger beside the timid!

text: Be slow, but never stop.
author: 이솝
kkaebi_comment: Slow is fine. Just don't stop — that's everything!

text: Knowledge is power.
author: 베이컨
kkaebi_comment: Knowledge becomes power when it seeps into your bones. Read today!

text: To thine own self be true.
author: 셰익스피어
kkaebi_comment: True to yourself, and nothing in the world is false!

text: Our doubts are traitors.
author: 셰익스피어
kkaebi_comment: Doubt betrays you. Try once, at least once!

text: Man is a thinking reed.
author: 파스칼
kkaebi_comment: A reed, yet great because it thinks. Don't be ashamed of thinking!

text: I think, therefore I am.
author: 데카르트
kkaebi_comment: Think, therefore build — your inner world first!

text: Two things fill me: the starry heavens and the moral law within.
author: 칸트
kkaebi_comment: Look at stars and morals. Those two are enough!

text: Knowing is not enough; we must apply.
author: 괴테
kkaebi_comment: Don't settle for knowing. Using it is truly knowing!

text: Perfect is the enemy of good.
author: 볼테르
kkaebi_comment: Let go of perfectionism. Good is good enough!

text: Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains.
author: 루소
kkaebi_comment: Count your chains — some you fastened yourself!

text: Everyone thinks of changing the world, but no one thinks of changing himself.
author: 톨스토이
kkaebi_comment: To change the world, look in the mirror first!

text: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
author: 니체
kkaebi_comment: With a why, any path is bearable. Find your why!

text: That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
author: 니체
kkaebi_comment: What doesn't kill you leaves steel-pattern scars!

text: Do not put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
author: 탈무드
kkaebi_comment: Do today's work today. Tomorrow's you will smile!

text: Who is strong? He who conquers himself.
author: 탈무드
kkaebi_comment: The strongest enemy is inside, not outside. Conquer it!

text: It is never too late to learn.
author: 솔론
kkaebi_comment: Learning while old means never growing old. Start now!

text: Lost time is never found again.
author: 프랭클린
kkaebi_comment: Time never returns. Know the worth of a single day!

text: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
author: 프랭클린
kkaebi_comment: One prevention beats ten repairs!

text: Life is either a daring adventure or nothing.
author: 헬렌 켈러
kkaebi_comment: Fearless, life is an adventure. Fearful, it is nothing!

text: Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.
author: 헬렌 켈러
kkaebi_comment: Small alone, great together! Who will you join today?

text: Every oak has been an acorn.
author: 에머슨
kkaebi_comment: The oak was once a mere acorn. Never scorn today's seed!

text: The only way to have a friend is to be one.
author: 에머슨
kkaebi_comment: Want a friend? Become one first. That's the only way!

text: Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.
author: 다 빈치
kkaebi_comment: Don't overwrap in complexity. Simplicity is ultimate sophistication!

text: Learning never exhausts the mind.
author: 다 빈치
kkaebi_comment: A learning mind never grows old!

text: The mind is not a vessel to be filled but a fire to be kindled.
author: 플루타르코스
kkaebi_comment: The mind is firewood to light, not a jar to fill. Throw logs in!

text: Seek death and live; seek life and die.
author: 이순신
kkaebi_comment: The resolve to die opens the road to live. Decide!

text: O youth, is there any place to send you back to?
author: 허난설헌
kkaebi_comment: Youth cannot be sent back. Burn today without regret!

text: Life is like carrying a heavy burden on a long road.
author: 도쿠가와 이에야스
kkaebi_comment: Heavy loads make long walks. Life was always like that!

text: Today, defeat yesterday's self; tomorrow, defeat today's self.
author: 무사시
kkaebi_comment: Beat yesterday's you. Today's enemy is not outside!

text: Summer grass — the traces of warriors' dreams.
author: 바쇼
kkaebi_comment: Under summer grass sleep countless dreams. The world is wide and deep!

text: When three walk together, one is surely my teacher.
author: 공자
kkaebi_comment: Among three people, there's a teacher. Learn one thing from today's encounter!

text: The highest good is like water.
author: 노자
kkaebi_comment: The highest good flows low like water!

text: He who knows contentment is rich.
author: 노자
kkaebi_comment: He who knows contentment is richest. Count what you have today!

text: Know the enemy and know yourself, and you will never be defeated.
author: 손자
kkaebi_comment: Know the enemy and yourself — a hundred battles without loss. Prepare!

text: When things do not go as planned, look within yourself.
author: 맹자
kkaebi_comment: When things fail, look in the mirror. The answer is inside!

text: Knowledge and action are one.
author: 왕양명
kkaebi_comment: Knowing and doing are one. Make them one today!
